SDN.note: The document is about the informatics crimes law amendment and states nothing on AI.

facts.fact: Sudan's Council of Ministers approved on 13 October 2025 a draft 2025 amendment to the Informatics Crimes Law, submitted by Justice Minister Abdullah Daraf, raising some penalties to seven and up to ten years and allowing electronic search and seizure of devices.

SDN.note: The document states nothing on a general data protection law.
The document states nothing on electronic transactions or e-commerce law.

facts.fact: The Sudanese Journalists' Syndicate, through its secretary general Mohamed Abdelaziz, criticised the 2025 amendments to the Informatics Crimes Law as a direct threat to freedom of expression and the press and called for wide consultation before passage.
